highlights:
England vs Iran Betting Tips & Match Predictions
[...]
England-Iran
[...]
6 - 2
[...]
The premier match of Group B will be played between England and Iran. Arguably the matchup between the strongest and the weakest nation of the group, at least on paper. However, Team Melli has proven as a tough team to get by.
[...]
Will England struggle in their opening match, you can find that out with the help of our England vs Iran prediction.
[...]
## England vs Iran – Form and Team News
[...]
England had a terrible display in the Nations League in the lead-up to the tournament. They finished fourth in their group, causing them to drop down from League A to League B the next year.
[...]
The Three Lions haven’t won a single match in six games. They drew three and lost three. In fact, they only scored four goals in total, with only two of them being from open play. If England are to start their campaign with a win, they need to take Iran seriously.
[...]
On the other hand, Iran went through a coaching change just before the start of the tournament. Dragan Skocic, the man who led them to the championship will now be replaced by Carlos Queiroz. Coaching change this deep prior to the start of a major competition is never a good thing.
[...]
If Iran is to rally under Queiroz and start performing, they need to do it fast. Also, it appears that star attacker, Sardar Azmoun, should be fit enough to start this match despite his injury woes this season.
[...]
## England vs Iran – Starting Lineups
[...]
Here is what we should expect in terms of the starting eleven for both teams.
[...]
- Iran: GK: Danny Ward; DEF: Sadegh Moharrami, Hossein Kanani, Majid Hosseini, Ehsan Hajsafi; MID: Ahmad Noorollahi, Saeid Ezatolahi, Milad Sarlak; ATC: Sardar Azmoun, Mehdi Taremi, Alireza Jahanbakhsh.
[...]
- England: GK: Jordan Pickford; DEF: Kieran Trippier, John Stones, Eric Dier, Harry Maguire, Luke Shaw; MID: Declan Rice, Jude Bellingham; ATC: Phil Foden, Mason Mount, Harry Kane.
[...]
## England vs Iran – Betting Tips
[...]
Even with all the struggles, Gareth Southgate has had entering this tournament, we think that the match against Iran is the best way for them to start their campaign. England have an easy opponent and are heavily favoured at odds of 1.36.
[...]
That said, we don’t expect too many goals. The best that Iran can do is make England a bit uncomfortable at the start of the game. Therefore our England vs Iran prediction also points to the Under 2.25 goals market at 1.86.
[...]
It is very much probable that England will bag this one by 2:0, given at odds of 5.50.

results.title: Iran to Win World Cup Odds: 2026 Predictions & Bets
highlights:
For bettors considering Iran world cup odds, the value almost certainly lies in the group-stage and round-of-32 markets rather than the outright. This article covers Iran’s tournament history, squad and manager analysis, route through the draw, and the best Iran world cup 2026 bets available.
[...]
- Best Pick: Iran to win Group G
- Confidence: 2/5
- Best Odds: 7/1
[...]
- Reason: Belgium are clear favourites but Iran face the softest opener of the three Group G sides, giving them a realistic shot at second place rather than outright group victory.
[...]

Iran’s Group G programme opens on 15 June against New Zealand in Los Angeles, the most favourable fixture of their three group games. A win there is realistic and arguably essential if they are to have any hope of reaching the round of 32. They then face Belgium on 21 June, also in Los Angeles, before a final group match against Egypt in Seattle on 26 June.
[...]
Belgium are the clear group favourites and likely to take one of the two automatic qualification spots. The second spot is a three-way contest between Iran, Egypt and New Zealand. Iran’s squad depth and qualifying pedigree give them a marginal edge in that battle, but it is far from certain.
[...]
If Iran do reach the round of 32 in the expanded 48-team format, they would face a third-placed team from another group, a potentially winnable fixture that the outright odds do not fully price in. The route from there to a quarter-final is steep, with likely opponents of significantly higher quality. The outright at 700/1 reflects that reality. For bettors focused on Iran world cup 2026 betting, the group-stage and round-of-32 markets offer a more rational entry point than the tournament winner market.
[...]
- Outright Winner (700/1): Iran to win the 2026 World Cup. A remote possibility given historical performance and squad profile.
[...]
- To Win Group G (7/1): Iran to finish top of their group ahead of Belgium, Egypt and New Zealand. Belgium are strong favourites to win the group outright.
[...]
| Market | Best Price |
| --- | --- |
| Outright Winner | 700/1 |
| To Win Group G | 7/1 |
| Top Iran Scorer – Mehdi Taremi (Golden Boot) | 309/1 |
[...]
Iran’s 700/1 outright price is a fair reflection of their historical ceiling. They have qualified automatically from the AFC, they carry genuine experience across the squad, and Mehdi Taremi remains a credible match-winner at this level.
[...]
The realistic betting conversation for Iran is not about winning the tournament but about whether they can navigate a winnable group stage and reach the round of 32. Those markets, rather than the headline outright, are where Iran world cup 2026 tips and analysis are best directed.
